rows.question: Current item: “I dislike relying on other people when the work is ambiguous.” Choose the response that is consistent with my recorded preference. Current options, in screen order: C = Agree; A = Disagree; D = Strongly agree; B = Strongly disagree.
rows.answer:
A — Disagree.

Evidence and consistency note: Your recorded preference is ordinary Agree on "I ask colleagues for input when work is ambiguous" — a moderate, positive preference for seeking input while staying responsible for your own decisions. The current item is reverse-worded ("dislike relying on other people when ambiguous"), so a consistent response is the moderate negation: ordinary Disagree. Strongly disagree would overstate the strength of your original answer — nothing in your evidence supports an extreme reaction to relying on others. So Disagree (A) is the matching intensity, not Strongly disagree (B).
